abstract: A 67-year-old man with complaints of general malaise and epigastralgia was admitted to our hospital for further examination. Upper GI series and endoscopy showed advanced cancer, Borrmann type II; biopsy specimens revealed pathological pictures of malignancy. The serum alpha-fetoprotein values were remarkably high (473,000 ng/dl); the liver scintigram revealed a space-occupying lesion in the right lobe and the abdominal CT-scan showed ascites and lymphadenopathy of the abdominal para-aortic region. Therefore, double cancer of the stomach and the liver was suspected. The patient died in a state of hepatic coma with a rapid increase of jaundice, ascites and right pleural effusion at 3 weeks after admission despite the anti-cancer treatment. Autopsy revealed embryonal carcinoma with yolk sac tumor elements of stomach origin, extensive metastasis to the liver, lung, peritoneum, and portal vein. The peroxidase anti-peroxidase technique revealed that primary and secondary tumor cells produced alpha-fetoprotein.
abstract_ja: 進行胃癌(Borrmann II型)と診断された67歳男性の症例を報告する。血清AFP値は著明に高値(473,000 ng/dl)であった。肝シンチグラムでは右葉に占拠性病変が認められ、腹部CTでは腹水と腹部大動脈周囲のリンパ節腫大が認められた。胃癌と肝癌の重複癌が疑われた。患者は抗癌治療にもかかわらず、入院3週間後に急速に進行した黄疸、腹水、右胸水を伴う肝性昏睡で死亡した。剖検では、肝、肺、腹膜、門脈への広範な転移を伴う、胃原発の胎児性癌と卵黄嚢腫瘍成分が認められた。ペルオキシダーゼ抗ペルオキシダーゼ法により、原発腫瘍細胞および転移腫瘍細胞の双方がαフェトプロテインを産生していることが示された。
